THE RULE
Even the ICO, the UK's data watchdog, uses this exact example.
An email sent to the wrong person.
THE RULE
If it's likely to put people at risk, you may have to report it to the ICO.
Within seventy-two hours.
THE RULE
And yes, weekends count. The clock starts when you find out.
THE RULE
And personal data isn't just bank details.
Names, addresses, emails, signatures. Contracts are full of it.
3 CHECKS
So before you hit send, three quick checks.
CHECK 1
One. Check the full email address.
Not just the first name autocomplete gives you.
CHECK 2
Two. Only send what's needed.
Do they really need the passport copy and the bank details?
CHECK 3
Three. If it does go wrong, write it down.
What happened, who it affected, and what you did about it.
